proposed_robot_motion_targets.first_gate: Arm reach, real shoulder range, head/shell/arm interference; then balance with moving arm masses.

proposed_robot_motion_targets.label_ko: 박자에 맞춰 좌우 흔들기·무릎 굽혔다 펴기
proposed_robot_motion_targets.first_gate: Initially keep both rear feet on the floor; solve contact forces, friction and motor load throughout the motion.
Transfer load before lifting a foot; verify single-support balance, foot clearance and landing.
Stepped turns with ground contact and tether routing; do not copy screen-space rotation as an airborne motion.

engineering_screen.scope: Four designer-chosen forepaw targets in the existing ideal-axis V2 model. These coordinates are not measurements extracted from the videos. Positive elbow branch and existing joint limits; no limit changes to make poses pass.
engineering_screen.coordinate_frame: Metres relative to pelvis; +x forward, +y robot left, +z up. Target y is mirrored per arm. Torso upright at existing reference height.

architecture_status: The 19-axis V2 configuration remains a comparator. Arm/neck/waist axis additions are not selected. Current neck is pitch-only and torso rigid; independent head roll/yaw or waist twist must not be advertised as present.
next_gate: Use required gesture reach and physical packaging together to select shoulder axes/ranges before freezing CAD. Preserve quadruped reach and self-righting paths. Adapt dance to valid ground contacts instead of copying floating image trajectories.
